description: Source code for WebSocket protocol handling, including frame encoding/decoding, request/response key generation, and control message management within the WebSocketLink.cpp file.

classes.name: Protocol
classes.description: Handles WebSocket handshake key generation, frame encoding/decoding, and control message processing.

methods.name: RequestKey
methods.description: Generates a base64-encoded random key for WebSocket handshake request.

methods.name: ResponseKey
methods.description: Computes the WebSocket handshake response key based on the request key.

methods.name: Encoder
methods.description: Encodes data frames for WebSocket transmission, including masking and frame type handling.

methods.name: Decoder
methods.description: Decodes incoming WebSocket frames, handling masking, fragmentation, and control frames.
